items.name: Wabanaki Nations Maine iGaming partnership expansion
items.claim: Caesars Entertainment announced the expansion of its existing partnership with three Wabanaki Nations (the Houlton Band of Maliseet Indians, the Mi'kmaq Nation and the Penobscot Nation) to include online casino gaming in Maine, positioning for a potential iGaming launch in the state in 2026, pending regulatory approvals.
items.source_excerpt: Caesars Entertainment, Inc. (NASDAQ: CZR) (“Caesars”) today announced the expansion of its existing partnership with three Wabanaki Nations: the Houlton Band of Maliseet Indians, the Mi’kmaq Nation and the Penobscot Nation, to include online casino gaming in Maine. The long-term agreement positions Caesars and its tribal partners for a potential iGaming launch in the state in 2026, pending regulatory approvals.
